description: Coverage matrix for the advertised haskell.nix baseline. Comparison rows have real targets on both sides. Failing rows are required haskell.nix parity capabilities that penance does not implement yet.

phases.title: Cabal project translation
phases.notes: Measures one repent solver run that writes the checked benchmark lock against one haskell.nix cabalProject' / plan-nix output. The broader lock correctness proof remains checks.repent-lock-proof.

phases.title: Cabal component derivations
phases.notes: Tracks the advertised component-derivation baseline with the lock-built penance benchmark executable from penanceProject.

phases.title: Backpack project build
phases.notes: Tracks Backpack build parity on the local multi-instantiation fixture.

phases.title: Hackage package-set builds
phases.notes: Builds pinned StateVar-1.2.2 from Hackage on the penance package-set lane and compares it with haskell.nix hackage-package.

phases.title: Stackage snapshot package-set builds
phases.notes: Parses StateVar's version from the pinned lts-24.41 Stackage snapshot on the penance lane, verifies the built package matches that resolved version, and compares it with haskell.nix snapshots.lts-24.41.StateVar.

phases.title: shellFor development environment
phases.notes: Uses the same ghcWithPackages-composed GHC package DB as devShells.default, proves cabal build all compiles the fixture without external dependency builds, and compares it with haskell.nix shellFor.

phases.title: Haskell project cross compilation
phases.notes: Builds the cross-hello Haskell executable as an aarch64-linux ELF through the raw cross-GHC lane and compares it with haskell.nix projectCross.aarch64-multiplatform. Both lanes intentionally share the same raw cross-GHC; this row measures raw invocation versus haskell.nix projectCross and Setup machinery, not a second haskell.nix compiler bootstrap.

phases.title: Project variants, modules, and overrides
phases.notes: Builds penance unit and dyndrv module artifacts from the same committed lock, byte-compares their run outputs in penanceProjectVariants, includes a real ghcOptions-O0 override variant, and compares the bundle with a haskell.nix appendModule GHC-options variant bundle.

phases.title: Tests, benchmarks, and checks collection
phases.notes: Builds and runs the fixture test suite and benchmark on the penance raw-GHC path and on haskell.nix components.tests / components.benchmarks outputs.

phases.title: Plan materialization and cache workflow
phases.notes: Builds a penance cache manifest keyed by the committed penance.lock hash and root drv path, and compares it with a haskell.nix project whose plan-nix is supplied through the materialized argument.
